assign.now: cross-referencing all 173 non-exempt page.js files against their parents' children: (and Doc's overview:) declarations

log.msg: Scope: 481 page.js total under public/framework/. 308 are under core/new/** (exempt per brief, includes core/new/page.js itself). 173 non-exempt. No alex/arya/castin/edric/michael or core/legacy dirs exist under public/framework/ (those personal-sandbox dirs live at public/ top level, outside this sweep's scope) -- so the exempt total is 308, all from core/new/**.

Method: wrote a Python balanced-bracket parser (scratchpad/parse_children.py + crossref.py) implementing Page.class.js declare()'s real algorithm -- string children: split on whitespace (literal names, not slugged), array elements (bare strings = literal names, [title,null] tuples = slug(title), everything else inline/exempt), object-literal {key:null} = slug(key). Cross-referenced every non-exempt page.js's directory name against its parent directory's page.js declared set.

Caught and fixed 3 parser bugs before trusting output (matches the brief's warning about a prior scout's errors): (1) a `this.children` member-access guard skipped whitespace BACKWARD ACROSS NEWLINES to find a preceding `.`, so a `//comment.` ending in a period on the line above a real `children:` property made the parser silently skip it -- this alone hid ui/page.js:18 (19 real children) and all 23 of styles/layouts/page.js's children, producing ~40 false orphans on a first pass. (2) `"a b".split(" ").map(fn)` was misread as a literal string. (3) multi-line string concatenation (`"model " + "fit flex " + ...`, styles/layouts/page.js:18-23) was not recognized as a plain name list, again producing false orphans for all 23 styles/layouts/* children until handled.

Second real mechanism found: `overview:` (not `children:`) on a Doc subclass. Doc.overview_section() (ext/doc/Doc.js:68-79) calls this.add("overview", { children: this.overview, ... }) -- so `overview: "a b"` on e.g. audit/page.js:27 creates an in-memory child page at <url>overview/ whose OWN children: is that string. This properly declares core/Page/overview/{add,catalog,children,dashboard,deep,docs,labels,landing,page,route,shapes,site,strip,wall}/ (14, via core/Page/page.js:14-16), audit/overview/{organization,priorities}/ (2, via audit/page.js:27), and ext/doc/overview/urls/ (1, via ext/doc/page.js:13). These are real, reader-reachable pages (Doc's Overview tab renders them) -- verified via code, not orphans, just declared through a second keyword the brief's children:-only wording didn't anticipate.
